# Roboparty RPO robot description

Source: https://github.com/Roboparty/roboto_origin, `modules/rpo_description/`, commit
`c71fd9287d28104dca111d7c25b908fa3f45f8e4`. Copyright Shanghai RoboParty Technology Co., Ltd. ("RoboParty").

Licence: CERN Open Hardware Licence Version 2 - Weakly Reciprocal (CERN-OHL-W-2.0), in `LICENSE` here, as
`modules/rpo_description/LICENSE` and `LICENSES.md` of the source state for this directory.

Contents:

- `mjcf/rpo.xml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`: unmodified copies from the source.
- `meshes/*.STL`: unmodified, not committed (31 MB); `python -m ai_embedded_dynamic_diversity.rl.rpo_body`
  downloads them at the pinned commit.
- `mjcf/rpo_standin.xml`, `mjcf/rpo_standin.json`: generated by `src/ai_embedded_dynamic_diversity/rl/rpo_body.py`
  from `mjcf/rpo.xml`. Modifications: the torque motors are replaced by position servos with the PD gains and
  torque limits of roboparty_train (`robolab/assets/robots/roboparty.py`, BSD-3-Clause); the timestep is 5 ms
  with the implicit-fast integrator and contact solref 0.02; sole, impact and sensor sites are added; the
  standing pose is the roboparty_train default joint positions at touchdown.

No RoboParty name, logo or product mark is used beyond identifying the source. The GPL-licensed parts of
roboto_origin (deployment, firmware, navigation, teleoperation) are not used.
